terminals.name: runs-viewer
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; poetry run python examples/cli/create_demo_trace.py --trace-file .aisuite/demo.jsonl --cwd . && poetry run python -m aisuite.tracing.viewer --trace-file .aisuite/demo.jsonl --artifact-root .aisuite/artifacts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
